text.card: A red giant 11,572 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 10, give 1.13 solar masses and 12.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,070 K at its surface.
